Property Description

Experience elevated family living in this spacious 4-bedroom villa with a maid's room in La Tilia at Villanova Phase 1, a thoughtfully planned community designed for modern lifestyles. Offering an expansive built-up area of 4,364.98 sq. ft., this exceptional home blends elegant architecture, generous living spaces, and contemporary finishes to create the perfect setting for comfortable everyday living.

The villa features bright open-plan living and dining areas, enhanced by large windows that invite abundant natural light while creating a seamless connection to the outdoor spaces. The modern kitchen is designed with practicality and style in mind, offering ample storage and workspace for effortless meal preparation and entertaining.

Each of the four bedrooms is generously proportioned, providing privacy and comfort for every family member. The six well-appointed bathrooms showcase premium fittings and sleek finishes, while the maid's room adds convenience and flexibility for larger households. Outdoor areas provide excellent potential for landscaping, family gatherings, or simply relaxing in a peaceful environment.

Scheduled for handover in September 2028, this villa presents an excellent opportunity for both end users and investors seeking a home within one of Dubai's most sought-after master communities. Residents will enjoy beautifully landscaped surroundings, family-friendly amenities, and easy access to schools, retail destinations, and major road networks, making everyday living both convenient and enjoyable.
